findings.evidence: roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/OneParameterSemigroups/README.md:167-176 lists the Bernstein object and the correspondence/representation API; lines 195-196 instead name completely-monotone examples e^{-t} and 1/(1+t), not these Bernstein examples.
findings.fix: Have a human add the standard Bernstein-function catalogue to the roadmap before merging, or rework the PR to supply a demonstrated prerequisite for an existing Part B target.
findings.issue: Part B does not call for a catalogue of fractional-power, logarithmic, or ramp Bernstein functions; its Bernstein targets are the Stieltjes/Bernstein correspondences and Lévy–Khinchine representation, neither of which these four declarations advance.

summary: The new catalogue is coherent, but it has no proximate path to the cited roadmap target.
